desc:
Florence, 2039. The drones arrived. Nobody invited them. Six Hubs fell. One light is left, and it just woke up. Hello, Pilot.

Anime and mecha Guardians hold the path together. Place one. Upgrade him. Open a crate and pick who comes. Co-op for 3 to 5 players, one path, ten waves, and a Commander with nobody inside.

Story mode tells you why they came. Day 1 pays. Tomorrow pays more. The light stays on.
